## Shared scenes

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) walks with [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) and hears about his toothache before encountering [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), who hurls insults at her. She then visits [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) to urge him to return to church and support the minister's salary. After initially fleeing his fierce reaction, [Faith](../character/faith.md) returns in anger to confront him, which amuses Douglas enough to apologize and accept her bargain.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053)_

> After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P42](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0042), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P63](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0063)_

> Walter reports his courage to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who comforts him after his fight. Downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss Walter's fight and gossip about Mr. Meredith's potential romance with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>
